title: Settings
snapshotHint: Changes only affect new quotes; existing ones keep their snapshot.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.newRequired: New password must be at least 8 characters

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.caption: Devices that are currently signed in to your account.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.sortableCaption: Allows reordering stations, sections and items by dragging. When off, the order stays fixed.

quoteBuilder.title: Quote builder
quoteBuilder.allowSelectOptionsAtQuote: Allow choosing options at quote time
quoteBuilder.allowSelectOptionsAtQuoteCaption: When off, the builder's "Choose options now" toggle is hidden — every quote defers option selection to the event. Existing quotes keep whatever they already saved.

quotePdfTemplate.title: PDF template
quotePdfTemplate.caption: Fixed text printed on the PDF of every generated quote.
quotePdfTemplate.servicesCaption: Printed as "Station: Duration" under the "SERVICE DURATION" section of the PDF.
quotePdfTemplate.serviceDurationPlaceholder: E.g. Up to 2 hours of service
quotePdfTemplate.termsAndConditionsCaption: One term per line — badges show up below as you type. Printed as a bullet list; leave this empty to skip that section in the PDF.
quotePdfTemplate.termsAndConditionsPlaceholder:
The deposit is non-refundable
Prices may vary based on availability
quotePdfTemplate.validityNoteCaption: Shown next to the totals in the PDF (e.g. "Prices are valid for...").
quotePdfTemplate.dietaryNoteCaption: Shown at the bottom of the "Services Included" page (only if the quote has items with details).

quoteDefaults.title: Quotes
quoteDefaults.depositRateCaption: Percentage of the total charged as a deposit when a quote is confirmed.
quoteDefaults.quoteValidityMonthsCaption: How many months a quote stays valid before it expires.
quoteDefaults.minPersonsPerLineCaption: Minimum number of people required per station on a quote.
quoteDefaults.quoteSeqStartCaption: Number the next quote sequence will start from.
quoteDefaults.currencyCaption: Currency used to display quote amounts.
quoteDefaults.optionsSelectionDeadlineDaysCaption: Days before the event date by which the client's option choices should be confirmed.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Read-only view of what each role can do. Roles and permissions can't be created, edited, or assigned here.

dashboard.caption: Overview metrics and KPIs on the home screen.

event_type.caption: Event type definitions used across the catalog.

quote_defaults.label: Quote defaults
quote_defaults.caption: Default deposit, validity, minimum persons, sequence and currency for new quotes.

quote_stages.label: Quote stages
quote_stages.caption: Labels, colors and descriptions of the quote pipeline stages.

catalog_preferences.caption: Whether the product catalog can be reordered by dragging.
